lead: An item reading "this match has no catch-all" cannot be met literally: `nvs_syntax::ast::TypeKind`, `TypeAtom` and `nvs_types::ty::Ty` are `#[non_exhaustive]`, so another crate must carry a trailing arm and is never told which variant it forgot.
body: Spell every variant the enum has, make the trailing arm say `this is a bug` (`tools/holes.py`'s `ENGINE` skips that, and `REFUSAL` never matched it), and add a probe asserting the row count — that count is the guard the compiler will not be.
